keyEvents.text: Goal! Tavernes 0, Valencia 1. Dani Raba (Valencia) left footed shot from very close range to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Aimar Blázquez.
Filip Ugrinic (Valencia) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! Tavernes 0, Valencia 2. Hugo Duro (Valencia) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the centre of the goal. Assisted by Dani Raba with a through ball.
Goal! Tavernes 0, Valencia 3. Luis Rioja (Valencia) left footed shot from the right side of the six yard box to the top right corner. Assisted by Arnau Martínez with a headed pass following a corner.
Marc Talens (Tavernes) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! Tavernes 0, Valencia 4. Harvey Elliott (Valencia) from a free kick with a left footed shot to the bottom left corner.
First Half ends, Tavernes 0, Valencia 4.
Substitution, Tavernes. Erik Martínez replaces Marc Talens.
Substitution, Tavernes. Jorge Seral replaces Joan Talens.
Second Half begins Tavernes 0, Valencia 4.
Luis Rioja (Valencia) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! Tavernes 0, Valencia 5. Aimar Blázquez (Valencia) right footed shot from very close range to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Luis Rioja.
Substitution, Valencia. Iker Córdoba replaces Copete.
Substitution, Valencia. Aaron Mayol replaces Dani Raba.
Substitution, Tavernes. Jesús Prats replaces Edu Alberola.
Substitution, Tavernes. Sergio Bono replaces Edu Palomares.
Goal! Tavernes 0, Valencia 6. Aimar Blázquez (Valencia) right footed shot from very close range to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Luis Rioja with a cross.
Substitution, Valencia. Arnaut Danjuma replaces Aimar Blázquez.
Substitution, Valencia. Justin de Haas replaces Arnau Martínez.
Substitution, Valencia. José Gayà replaces Luis Rioja.
Substitution, Tavernes. Román Palero replaces Joan Brines.
Second Half ends, Tavernes 0, Valencia 6.
